propositions.text: Applicant is Mr. Dharamjit Singh Grewal seeking judicial review of officer's refusal of work permit application.
Officer refused application because Applicant did not establish he would leave Canada after stay, per subsection 200(1)(b) IRPR.

paragraphs.summary: Applicant Grewal seeks judicial review of officer's refusal of work permit for failure to prove he would leave Canada after stay, court states.

propositions.text: Applicant is an Indian citizen who applied in February 2023 for a work permit outside Canada as a General Farm Worker in BC.

paragraphs.summary: Applicant is Indian citizen who applied in February 2023 for BC farm worker work permit outside Canada, court states.

propositions.text: Officer found Applicant did not show sufficient establishment in India based on savings and assets.

paragraphs.summary: Officer found Applicant lacked sufficient establishment in India based on savings and assets, court reports.

propositions.text: Applicant argues breaches of procedural fairness due to inability to address Officer's concerns and reasonable apprehension of bias.

paragraphs.summary: Applicant argues procedural fairness breaches from inability to address concerns and apprehension of bias, court reports.

propositions.text: Applicant submits decision was unreasonable because Officer failed to consider evidence of financial establishment in India.

paragraphs.summary: Applicant submits decision unreasonable as Officer failed to consider financial establishment evidence, court reports.

propositions.text: Respondent argues Officer met procedural fairness standard for work permit application.

paragraphs.summary: Respondent argues Officer met procedural fairness standard, court reports.

propositions.text: Respondent argues Officer reasonably reviewed evidence and reasonably denied application.

paragraphs.summary: Respondent argues Officer reasonably reviewed evidence and denied application, court reports.

propositions.text: Procedural fairness issues in judicial review are reviewed on correctness standard per Canada (Citizenship and Immigration) v Khosa.

paragraphs.summary: Procedural fairness issues reviewed on correctness standard per Khosa, court states.

propositions.text: Following Vavilov, Officer's decision is reviewable on reasonableness standard.

paragraphs.summary: Officer's decision reviewable on reasonableness standard per Vavilov, court states.

propositions.text: Reasonableness requires decision to show justification, transparency, intelligibility, and be justified by relevant facts and law per Vavilov para 99.

paragraphs.summary: Reasonableness requires justification, transparency, intelligibility, and justification by facts and law per Vavilov, court states.

propositions.text: Applicant failed to show any breach of procedural fairness by Officer after considering evidence and submissions.

paragraphs.summary: Court finds Applicant failed to show breach of procedural fairness by Officer after review.

propositions.text: Procedural fairness for work permit applications is at lower end of scale per Anenih v Canada.

paragraphs.summary: Procedural fairness for work permits is low standard per Anenih, court states.

propositions.text: Test for bias allegation is high per Committee for Justice & Liberty v Canada (NEB).

paragraphs.summary: Test for bias allegation is high per Committee for Justice & Liberty v Canada (NEB), court states.

propositions.text: Applicant did not identify specific evidence supporting bias allegation.
Applicant has not established bias by Officer.

paragraphs.summary: Applicant did not identify evidence for bias; court finds no bias established.

propositions.text: Applicant did not show breach of procedural fairness; responsibility for sufficiency of materials was his; Officer not obliged to raise concerns.

paragraphs.summary: Court finds no procedural fairness breach; Applicant responsible for materials; Officer not obliged to raise concerns.

propositions.text: Court not persuaded decision is unreasonable after reviewing materials and submissions.

paragraphs.summary: Court not persuaded decision is unreasonable after review, court states.

propositions.text: Officer commented on relevant matters including lack of bank statements; conclusion reasonable relative to materials.

paragraphs.summary: Court finds Officer's comments relevant and conclusion reasonable relative to materials.

propositions.text: No basis for judicial intervention; application for judicial review dismissed; no question for certification.

paragraphs.summary: Court dismisses judicial review application with no question for certification, court orders.
